title: Park City, Utah Travel Guide
overview: Park City combines major attractions with regional outdoor access and historical sites.

thingsToDo.title: Explore Utah Olympic Park
thingsToDo.description: Utah Olympic Park was built for the 2002 Winter Olympics in the Wasatch Range near Park City and later converted into a year-round training and visitor venue. The complex includes ski jumps, bobsled and luge facilities, and museum exhibits documenting Olympic and Paralympic history in Utah. Its competition infrastructure was designed to international standards under the Salt Lake Organizing Committee and is now operated by the Utah Olympic Legacy Foundation. Elevation, venue engineering, and continued athlete use distinguish it from typical resort attractions. Because the site remains active decades after the Games, it demonstrates how Park City integrated mega-event investment into long-term sports development, tourism programming, and regional identity.
